question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**ensure**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the need to maintain proper staffing levels in healthcare services.
 
• The word to be filled should indicate the requirement for maintaining or securing continuous, adequate staffing.
 
• "**Ensure**" fits well as it means to make certain that something will occur or be the case.
 
• Other options ("**treat**", "**animate**", "**scrutinise**") do not fit the context of ensuring continuous staffing in healthcare facilities.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Treat (इलाज करना): "Treat" means to deal with medically or look after in a specified manner, which does not fit the context of staffing needs.
 
• Animate (जीवंत करना): "Animate" means to bring to life, which does not fit the context of ensuring staffing levels.
 
• Scrutinise (गहराई से जांचना): "Scrutinise" means to examine or inspect closely, which does not align with the context of ensuring staff levels.
